verdict.rationale: Mintlify's automations (scheduled/triggered agent runs) produce pull requests that go through preview deployments and editor review/merge before publishing, giving a clear versioning-and-review workflow built on Git. However, rollback is never explicitly documented as a feature — it's only implied via underlying Git history rather than a first-class rollback UI or command. Missing for 10: explicit rollback/revert tooling or documentation, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of the review-then-rollback loop for automations specifically.
